gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no laboratory specimen-type evidence or predicate, and the source HL7 specimen value set has no codes; generic Mycobacterium and organism-test branches requiring separate extrapulmonary specimen linkage are omitted from NMIE-R2 through NMIE-R5 while extrapulmonary-specimen-specific test-name branches remain modeled
the authoritative source marks these reporter types unavailable in RCKMS; reporter-type routing and the death-certificate criterion are not represented in the condition pack
